sloka: तं ब्रह्मा लोकपालानां सहांशैः समयोजयत् ।ततो ददौ नृपं तासां प्रजानामीश्वरं क्षुपम् ।। ७.७६.४३ ॥
transliteration: taṁ brahmā lokapālānāṁ sahāṁśaiḥ samayojayat ।tato dadau nṛpaṁ tāsāṁ prajānāmīśvaraṁ kṣupam ।। 7.76.43 ॥

translations.english: Brahma then endowed him (Kṣupa) with the shares of splendor from the protectors of the worlds, and then gave King Kṣupa as the ruler of those subjects.
